method: Round-5 additions: 8-12 pharmaceutical PATENTS chosen to widen DRAWING STYLES/languages (CJK JP+KR+CN, French and German EPO B1, condensed/stereo-as-letters scans, two-component salts drawn as such). Same scoreable schema as pdf_manifest_round34.json. Every resolved molecule required TWO independent views to agree: a PubChem lookup by a name/CAS printed in the document, OR - where only a Roman-numeral label is printed - a PubChem same-connectivity structure search on the drawn reading; AND a reading of the drawing. Every SMILES round-trips through RDKit (parse + InChIKey verified equal to the recorded inchikey). confidence: name_match | drawing_read | unresolved | generic. pixel_verified is false everywhere (real documents).
excluded: Structures DRAWN but carrying no resolvable SMILES live in each group's `unscoreable` array (never in `molecules`, which score_run.py calls Chem.MolFromSmiles on). `unscoreable` holds Markush/R-group generics (generic:true) and any structure with no second independent view (confidence:unresolved). Repeat drawings of one compound are collapsed to ONE row (matched by name), with every page listed.

counts._note: structures_drawn, generic and unresolved are DEPICTION counts (same unit). molecules_scoreable counts rows in `molecules` (distinct compounds). The 24 generic depictions are described by 10 `unscoreable` rows and the 2 unresolved depictions by 2 rows, because near-duplicate generics are grouped.

EP0308341NWB1_perindopril.drawing_style: French-language granted European patent (EP B1, Servier), served by the EPO publication server. 300-dpi JBIG2 bitonal full-page SCANS with an OCR text layer. A mixed drawing style the corpus lacks: bicyclic ring SKELETONS with stereochemistry carried by printed S/R LETTERS on the atoms, alongside fully CONDENSED structural formulae (HO-OC-CH(CH3)-NH-...) for the side chains, and salt counterions written as text labels ('PTS', tert-butylamine named).
EP0308341NWB1_perindopril.note: French EP B1 (perindopril process). 14 distinct structure depictions (several redrawn in the trilingual claims): 8 specific+scoreable (I, IIaS, V, VI, VII, VIII, IX, X) and 6 generic-ester depictions (III, IV, and the four diastereomers IIa-IId). The claims section (p15-17) redraws I, IIaS, V, IX etc. - repeats collapsed to the rows above via the page list. Two two-component salts appear as drawn/labelled counterions: formula (IX) benzyl ester with 'PTS' (p-toluenesulfonate) drawn beside it, and the TARGET formula (I) whose tert-butylamine salt (perindopril erbumine) is named in every claim though the drawing shows only the free acid. Non-structure content: none (no spectra); the document is text + structures.

EP3337801B1_finerenone.drawing_style: German-language granted European patent (EP B1, Bayer), Acrobat Distiller. Vector ChemDraw line-art with wedge/hash stereo. A 6-page extract (original doc pages 3-8) carrying the two research/production reaction SCHEMES; the full 74-page grant additionally has Beispiele that redraw these compounds and NMR data.
EP3337801B1_finerenone.note: Structure-DENSE German process patent for finerenone (Kerendia). This is a 6-page extract (doc pp3-8) of the 74-page EP B1, chosen because every drawn compound is a SPECIFIC, PubChem-resolvable intermediate - there is no Markush anywhere in these schemes. 21 distinct compounds: the (4S) drug (I) and its (4R) distomer ent-(I) named+drawn on p1; the 12-step research synthesis (Schema 1, pp2-3: II-XIII); the improved route (Schema 2, pp4-5) adding VIa/VIb; and the halobenzoic-acid route to the aldehyde (pp6: XIV, XIVa, XV, XVI). Most intermediates carry ONLY a Roman-numeral label (no printed chemical name), so they are `drawing_read`: each was read off the drawing and confirmed by a PubChem same-connectivity search whose InChIKey matched the read. Compounds redrawn across schemes are collapsed to one row with all pages listed. NOT INCLUDED: the fully-aromatic pyridine Formel (XVII) (CID 126623403) used in the enantiomer-recycle loop is drawn only in a later Beispiel outside this extract, so it is named here but not scored. No spectra are inside this extract.

US3781268_kanamycin.drawing_style: 1973 USPTO scan - the WOBBLIEST hand-drawn era in the corpus. Aminoglycoside CHAIR-conformation sugar rings drawn freehand, every substituent a typewriter-style condensed label (HO, H2N, NH2, CH2OH, CH2NH2), no wedges anywhere, ring-oxygen drawn as a bare vertex.

NOTE the corpus lesson repeated here - the front page says 'No Drawing' and the specification is nonetheless full of inline structures.

Hand-inked carbapenem line art with condensed side-chain labels (SCH2CH2N=C(R)NH2, COOH, COO-) - plus an ABBREVIATION DEVICE the corpus has never had: a bracket box labelled 'Th' standing for the entire bicyclic thienamycin nucleus, with only the OH, N and CO2H drawn outside it.

Depiction accounting: 16 total = 7 full-structure depictions (thienamycin, imipenem, the isourea.HCl twice, 2,4,5-trichlorophenol, N-trifluoroacetimidoyl, N-acetimidoyl) covering 6 distinct compounds, of which 5 resolve and 1 (the trifluoroacetimidoyl) does not; plus 9 generic depictions (formula (II) three times and six 'Th' shorthand boxes).
